digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter seam (Cloud + Data Center)
propositions: rebar cannot reconcile self-hosted Jira Data Center instances because the existing adapter is Cloud-only, coupled to ADF rich text and accountId-based user identity.
The previous approach (PR #120's separate adapter) duplicated field maps and sanitizers across two packages with no enforced contract, creating drift between Cloud and DC implementations.

The Jira family must be restructured as an explicit sub-seam with extracted shared logic (field maps, sanitizers, link relations, probe classifier) parameterized by contracts (RichTextCodec for ADF vs wiki/plain text, UserIdentityModel for accountId vs name) rather than forked implementations.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) loaded by path cannot physically relocate without breaking the dynamic loader, so sharing must occur via dependency inversion (importing from jira_family) rather than file relocation.

The DC transport requires TLS-encrypted base_url by default (rejectable only via allow_insecure override), never disables certificate verification, reads PAT from JIRA_PAT environment variable only (never config file), and respects operator-configured resolved_statuses to avoid misclassifying DC workflow states as Cloud states.

Bidirectional reconciliation against a real Jira 8.17.1 Data Center instance must demonstrate inbound issue creation and outbound mutation propagation, with zero unhandled exceptions and correct provenance identity (shared jira channel, disambiguated by RemoteRef.instance).
